QUOTE: If that define is set, the default is `platform_calloc_uninit` (`platform.c:25-33`), which always returns NULL. The same applies to free (`platform.c:36-45`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the uninit calloc always returns NULL and that the default "will fail every allocation", but it never says the uninit free does nothing; it only says "the same applies" without stating that behaviour.
